=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines 5881-5882 (new skip branch: `if type tg_alert_configured >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! tg_alert_configured "${JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL}"; then echo "rb-judge-security-hold dedupe skipped ..."`), together with lines 6042-6053 (`rb_security_hold_msg_id="$(tg_send_msg "${MSG}" "${JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL}")"` ... `echo "::warning::rb-judge-security-hold page not confirmed by Telegram for PR #${PR_NUMBER}; no marker, the next round pages again."`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip branch does not pass the "Telegram cannot send" result to the send block, so RB_SECURITY_HOLD_REPEAT stays "unchecked" and line 6042 still sends directly; tg_send_msg returns 0 with empty output (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:134-143), and the else branch at line 6053 emits a `::warning::`.
  WHY: Repos with no TG_BOT_SECRET or with ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT get a warning saying "the next round pages again" on every judge round, though no round can page, and log analysis picks it up; before this PR the path used tg_send_tracked and returned silently; noise only, and the suggested fix is to set RB_SECURITY_HOLD_TG_UNAVAILABLE=true in the skip branch and use a plain echo at 6053.
- agents.d/9283-security-pass-lost-audits.md:line 5, the `RB_JUDGE_SECURITY_HOLD_ALERT` bullet under `<!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" -->`: "`repeat=unchecked` means the comment read failed and the alert still pages" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The contractual bullet was not updated for the new skip path, in which `repeat=unchecked` is logged with no comment read attempted (review_autofix.yml:5878, 5881-5882, 5904), and it contradicts the updated "Workflow architecture" bullet on line 2.
  WHY: Operators and log analysis would misread a repo without Telegram as one that pages every round; the suggested one-line fix is "`repeat=unchecked` means the comment read failed, or was skipped because Telegram cannot send at that level; the alert pages whenever Telegram can send".
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer verified every issue #9942 deliverable. scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh and tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py appear in files_touched, but no deliverable requires them, because the dedupe went into the alert step per Approach item 3.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): these repeat the two findings above, with fixes estimated at 4 lines and 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines 5881-5882 (new skip branch) together with lines 6042-6043 and 6052-6053 (send block: `rb_security_hold_msg_id="$(tg_send_msg "${MSG}" "${JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL}")"` and the else branch `echo "::warning::rb-judge-security-hold page not confirmed by Telegram for PR #${PR_NUMBER}; no marker, the next round pages again."`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `tg_alert_configured` returns 1, `RB_SECURITY_HOLD_REPEAT` stays `unchecked`, so the send block runs; `tg_send_msg` returns 0 with empty output (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:129-143), and the else branch emits the false "the next round pages again" warning; the send block does not tell "cannot send" apart from "send not confirmed".
  WHY: Repos without TG_BOT_SECRET or a chat id, or with ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT, get a recurring false warning that log analysis picks up; alert gating itself is correct, and the new skip branch is where the warning should have been suppressed.
- agents.d/9283-security-pass-lost-audits.md:line 5, the `RB_JUDGE_SECURITY_HOLD_ALERT` bullet in the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" block: "`repeat=unchecked` means the comment read failed and the alert still pages" | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The line 2 "Workflow architecture" bullet was updated for the skip case, but the contractual line 5 bullet still defines `repeat=unchecked` only as a failed read that pages (review_autofix.yml:5878 sets it, 5881-5882 skip, 5904 logs it), so the two bullets contradict each other.
  WHY: A reader of the contract in a repo without Telegram would conclude that a comment read fails and the alert pages every round, when the reads are skipped by design and nothing pages; this is contract drift on a registry entry documented as contractual.
